Class UniversalGravesAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.compat.UniversalGravesAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
eu.pb4.graves.grave.GraveInventoryMask
public final class UniversalGravesAdapter extends Object implements eu.pb4.graves.grave.GraveInventoryMask
§0052 Phase 2 — Universal Graves adapter. Makes MKC player-slot contents land in a UG grave (and restore on collect), generic over every death-droppable player content slot via PlayerSlotCapture.

Optional dependency. This class references UG types (eu.pb4.graves.*, modCompileOnly) and is loaded ONLY behind a FabricLoader.isModLoaded("universal-graves") guard (in MKC.init). When UG is absent the class never loads, and the Phase-1 floor drops the slots beside the death spot. MKC hard-depends on UG not at all.

Ordering. UG's mask captures before vanilla's inventory drop (it injects ahead of dropEquipment), so PlayerSlotCapture.captureAndClear(ServerPlayer) here clears the slots upstream of the Phase-1 dropEquipment floor — the floor finds them empty and drops nothing (no dupes).

Identity. A captured slot's real identity is (attachmentId, index); that rides UG's per-item Tag (UG's own slot int is just a unique per-item key, since one mask spans multiple MKC attachments). On collect, restore decodes the tag and writes each stack back to the exact slot.
